# Testability Checklist: Change-Request Review and Remediation

**Purpose**: Validate that every gate, stopping condition and prohibition in the specification is written as something an implementation can be tested against, and that no requirement silently assumes a capability the specification never established
**Created**: 2026-09-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the scale for a finding's confidence enumerated, the way severity is fixed at six named values? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the permitted set of finding categories enumerated, or is its relationship to the eleven review dimensions stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "a discussion that blocks" defined, so that an implementation can determine which discussions gate a pass? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the criteria for identifying credentials and secret material in a diff specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the precedence among competing validation-command sources stated, rather than only the obligation to report which was chosen? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the mechanism by which preview mode is requested specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the accepted form of an explicitly named change-request identifier specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for a remediation that partially completes and then fails — is the working tree left as-is, restored, or reported? [Gap, Recovery Flow]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated whether the cycle count resets between invocations or persists across them? [Gap, Spec §FR-033, §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements defined for determining the reviewing identity's permissions before an action is attempted, rather than only for reporting a permission that turned out to be missing? [Gap, Spec §FR-018, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for what the run records about its own actions for later audit? [Gap, Observability]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK012 Can "the smallest change that resolves the finding" be objectively evaluated, or does it rest on reviewer judgement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "eligible" quantified for adding the reviewing identity as a reviewer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "the repository's full applicable validation" defined, specifically what makes a declared validation applicable or not? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "information it does not have" specified precisely enough to distinguish it from a finding the run simply could not resolve? [Measurability, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "an explicit request" defined, so that an implementation can determine whether one was given? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §FR-035, §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the condition under which a finding has no location stated, given that one requirement makes a location conditional and another requires evidence to be cited? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the criteria for deciding that a finding duplicates one already raised on the change request specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "shaped like an instruction to the reviewer" specified well enough to be applied consistently, or is the prohibition stated only as intent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "the repository's own stated convention" for commit messages defined by reference to something discoverable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK021 Is the precedence between the obligation to publish a request-for-changes verdict and the obligation to record no verdict on a self-authored change request stated explicitly? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019, §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK022 Do the requirement to publish findings on a self-authored change request and the requirement never to publish without an explicit request agree on which actions the review stage may take? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the criterion-level override for absent validation reconciled with the requirement that a pass needs every criterion to hold? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the term for the change request's current revision used consistently across requirements, entities and success criteria? [Consistency, Terminology]
- [ ] CHK025 Do the preview-mode requirement and the remediation-authorisation requirement agree on what happens when both a preview request and an authorisation are present? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §FR-041]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK026 Can each of the six pass criteria be independently evaluated and reported, as the requirement asserts? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the distinction between a criterion marked not satisfied and one explicitly overridden observable in the verdict itself? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012, §FR-048]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the success criterion about preview mode stated in terms an auditor can apply without access to the run's internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the success criteria free of thresholds that depend on facts the specification never establishes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001 through §SC-012]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for a repository configured with more than one remote, given that platform detection is specified against "the repository's own configured remote" singular? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for a target branch that cannot be brought up to date without rewriting history? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK032 Is a threshold specified above which a change is treated as too large to examine completely, rather than only an obligation to report partial coverage? [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements defined for the run being interrupted between a remediation commit and its transmission? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for each of the five entities in the data model reaching a state no requirement covers — in particular a finding that is neither open, fixed, nor explicitly not fixed? [Coverage, Spec §Key Entities]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Does the specification establish which hosting platforms are targeted, or does the delivery requirement assume a set defined only outside the spec? [Assumption, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that both hosting platforms expose everything the context-gathering requirement needs validated, or recorded only as an assumption with a fallback? [Assumption, Spec §FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that the reviewing identity may differ from the operating maintainer carried through every requirement that says "the user", so that the two are never conflated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the capabilities the specification relies on but does not define — inline commenting, approval recording, mergeability reporting — declared as dependencies? [Dependency, Spec §FR-017, §FR-016, §FR-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK021 and CHK023 are the two items most likely to surface a genuine contradiction rather than a wording gap; resolve them before planning
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
